style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: jute rope, jute sack and amber jug are kraft tan and gold: kraft keys, a marker-magenta Enter as the treat of the same craft world, butter soft keys, cream panel

images.why: Look: 'rope pieces above the tape'; Screen: 'rope pieces of 2.4 m, 1.35 m and 0.8 m over the tape'; the child 'drags the pieces end to end': one short rope piece (re-made as a tile: as a strip the rope came out a smooth bar) stretched by the tool to each piece's length
images.prompt: A short straight length of natural jute rope, made of thick twisted strands of pale straw-tan fibre, lying horizontally, with soft fuzzy fibres and neatly bound rounded ends.

images.object: kitchen scale with a jute sack of rice on its pan, blank face
images.why: Stage: 'The scale stands at x 300, y 300 with its dial reading kilograms'; Screen: 'a 6 kg bag on the scale': one scale body with the bag on its pan, the round face left blank so the dial and every number are drawn in code
images.prompt: A retro kitchen scale with a rounded butter-yellow enamel body, a shallow polished brass pan on top that holds a small tan jute sack of rice tied at the neck with twine, and a large, plain, smooth, round ivory face on its front, a blank face with nothing printed on it. Glossy, with a soft bevelled edge.

images.object: tall empty amber glass jug, plain sides
images.why: Stage: 'The jug is 200 wide and 360 tall'; Screen: 'the jug holding 1.4 L of juice'; the child 'pours out the cup, reads the jug': the jug is drawn once with plain sides, and the water level, the tenths marks and every number are drawn in code
images.prompt: A tall jug of thick warm amber-tinted glass, empty, with a comfortable curved handle on the right, a small pouring lip and a glossy rim. The sides are completely smooth and plain, with nothing printed or etched on them.
